name: io.github.bilbilmyc/memobox
title: memobox
description: Self-hosted long-term memory for AI agents: one MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP + stdio bridge), semantic + entity-graph retrieval, and a bilingual admin console with labeled retrieval benchmarks. Local mode needs only a SQLite file; server mode is a single Docker container with Postgres + pgvector.

host.description: Your memobox server host, e.g. memobox.example.com

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token, only if the operator set MCP_TOKEN on the server
